methodology.coldStart: Update function environment with a unique nonce, wait for update, then invoke once.
methodology.warmStart: Immediately invoke the same function and verify the Lambda log stream is unchanged.
methodology.wasmSelection: The 3000px JPEG workflows require full-resolution decode. WASM samples are accepted only when the loader instantiates exactly once and the warm invocation reuses it.
methodology.outputParity: Every workflow must produce one SHA-256 across cold and warm invocations, both architectures, and both engines where applicable.
methodology.operationTiming: Input read and output metadata validation are excluded from handler operationMs. WASM input and row-copy overhead remains inside operationMs.
methodology.awsTiming: AWS REPORT Duration and Init Duration are parsed from the synchronous log tail.
